Everything you need to ship from India to Jamaica or import from Jamaica to India: the trade agreement, routes and transit times, how your buyer imports, duties, regulators and documents.
India and Jamaica at a glance
No trade agreement with India. CARICOM Common External Tariff applies.
India exports pharmaceuticals, vehicles and auto parts, rice, textiles and machinery. India buys alumina and bauxite.
Routes and transit times to Jamaica
30–45 days to Kingston, a major Caribbean transhipment hub.
Transit times are indicative port-to-port from Nhava Sheva / Mundra (sea) and Delhi / Mumbai (air). Routing changes (for example Red Sea diversions) can add 10–14 days.
Importing into Jamaica: what your buyer needs
Declarations are filed on ASYCUDA with Jamaica Customs, usually through a customs broker.
Motor vehicle imports have age limits and specific rules.
CARICOM Common External Tariff, plus 15% General Consumption Tax (GCT) and other levies.
Ministry of Health – Standards and Regulation: medicines, food
Bureau of Standards Jamaica: product standards and labelling

From Jamaica to India, and tips from the field
File the Bill of Entry through a licensed customs broker in India (YAM holds licence R-7/92).
Check the HS code in the Indian tariff, the DGFT import policy (free, restricted or prohibited) and any BIS, FSSAI, plant quarantine or other permit before the goods ship.
If an agreement applies, get the correct certificate of origin from the exporter to claim the lower duty.
